### Documento oficial (copiado por la tarea): https://ufukavrupa.org.tr/en/news/eu10000-funding-available-valleys-knowledge-valorisation-toolbox-integration-pilots
VALLEYS Open Call #1 – Strand A: Toolbox Integration Pilots (call details and application: https://valleysproject.eu/open-calls/).
Eligibility: legal entities established in an EU Member State or a Horizon Europe Associated Country by the application deadline, operating as knowledge valorisation intermediaries. Eligible organisation types: SMEs, start-ups, NGOs, foundations, associations, universities, research organisations and public bodies. Examples of intermediaries include technology transfer offices, incubators and science parks.
Not eligible: natural persons, VALLEYS consortium members and their affiliated entities.
Applications must be submitted by a single legal entity. Consortium applications are not eligible.
Funding: up to €10,000 per project, at a 100% funding rate. Total Strand A budget: €70,000, for up to seven projects. Milestone-based lump sum: 10% initially, up to 45% at the interim stage, and the remainder after the final review.
Eligible activities: onboarding and configuring the Toolbox and training staff; data protection and information security assessments; baseline performance measurements, testing on real operational cases and comparing results to baseline indicators; deploying and testing at least one of four modules: IMPACT IP, Matchmaking Engine, Cascade Funding Cross-Referencer or Proposal Compliance Assistant. Each pilot must address at least one EU Code of Practice.
